name: Charge Type 8 Code
definition: Identifies charges linked to the conveyance of goods.

STDE.name: Storage At Destination
STDE.definition: Charge is for storage of goods at destination.

STOR.name: Storage At Origin
STOR.definition: Charge is for storage of goods at origin.

PACK.name: Packaging
PACK.definition: Charge is for packaging of goods.

PICK.name: Pick Up
PICK.definition: Charge is for pick-up of goods.

INSU.name: Insurance Premium
INSU.definition: Charge is a premium for insurance.

COLF.name: Collect Freight
COLF.definition: Charge is for the collection of the freight.

CHOR.name: Clearance And Handling At Origin
CHOR.definition: Charge is for clearance and handling of goods at origin.

CHDE.name: Clearance And Handling At Destination
CHDE.definition: Charge is for clearance and handling of goods at destination.

AIRF.name: Air Way Bill Fee
AIRF.definition: Charge is an airway bill fee.
